ticket_text: My Premium access just stopped working yesterday out of nowhere and I definitely didn't cancel it myself. Why did that happen?
summary: The customer says their Premium access stopped working unexpectedly and they did not cancel. The agent should explain common causes (failed renewals and what happens after cancelled subscriptions) and give a next step to check the subscription status and restore access if needed.
kb_quote: If all retries fail, Premium access ends and the subscription is marked as unpaid; update your payment method and resubscribe from Profile → Subscription to restore access.

drafts.formal:
Hello [Customer name],

A common reason Premium access stops is that a renewal or session payment fails (for example, due to an expired card). The system retries the charge automatically for up to 3 days; if all retries fail, Premium access ends and the subscription is marked as unpaid.

Please check your payment status and, if needed, update your payment method and then resubscribe from Profile → Subscription to restore access.

Sincerely,
[Agent name]
drafts.empathetic:

[Agent name] can help by having you update your payment method and resubscribe from Profile → Subscription to get your access back.

Best regards,
[Agent name]
drafts.short: Premium can stop working if a renewal payment fails; we retry automatically for up to 3 days. If retries fail, Premium ends and is marked unpaid—update your payment method and resubscribe via Profile → Subscription to restore access.

If you do not receive notifications even after turning them off/on, also confirm that the app’s notifications are allowed in your device settings.

Kind regards,
[Agent name]
